init.title: Prices for cost statistics
init.description: The energy dashboard cannot calculate costs for the imported Vivawest statistics itself. With a price set, the integration additionally imports a cost statistic (e.g. `vivawest:kaltwasser_kosten`), which you select in the energy dashboard under "Use an entity tracking the total costs". Changing a price recalculates all months the portal provides. The prices are also used to forecast the next settlement (actual consumption × price).

data_description.preis_wasser: Water supply and sewage per m³, used for cold and hot water.
data_description.preis_warmwasser_energie: Price per kWh for heating the hot water. For the heating costs forecast, use the consumption costs only, without base costs (consumption costs ÷ consumption from the heating cost settlement).
data_description.preis_heizenergie: Price per kWh of heating energy. For the heating costs forecast, use the consumption costs only, without base costs (consumption costs ÷ consumption from the heating cost settlement).
